one_liner: DeMar DeRozan scores 22 points per 36 minutes while shooting 32.6 percent from three -- volume built almost entirely inside the arc.
three_things: The scoring rate sits well above the three-point accuracy that usually supports it.
Where he does convert is the line: 85.7 percent on free throws.
Overall field-goal percentage holds at 48.3 across 228 games.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
